title: astragalus lagurus subsp. persicus
intro: Astragalus lagurus subsp. persicus, commonly known as Persian astragalus, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family and is native to the Middle East and Central Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Persian astragalus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Persian astragalus are responsible for its potential health benefits, including its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
